sources.quote: Commonly known as a ‘Mark 7,’ each life raft can hold up to 25 people.

sources.quote: This specification covers the 25-person (Mark-7) Mod 2 and 50-Person (Mark-8) Mod 2 inflatable life rafts, including inflation system and survival gear, packed within a rigid stowage container, ready for use as abandon ship survival equipment.
